title: Live-output provenance: per-chunk traces, metrics, and redaction hooks
creator: Aisha Romero
description: Implement comprehensive per-chunk provenance, metrics, and trace propagation for live/streamed outputs. Goals: (1) emit lightweight per-chunk metrics for latency, token counts, and origin (cache / model-variant / fallback), (2) create/open tracing spans tied to chunk boundaries and correlate them with request-level spans and any downstream tool/function calls, and (3) introduce a pluggable redaction hook so any chunk persisted to logs or telemetry is sanitized for PII before it leaves the runtime. This is targeted at improving root-cause analysis for long-running streams and making rollbacks/fallbacks visible in dashboards and traces.
acceptance_criteria: Per-chunk metrics emitted with stable names (examples below) and tags: stream.id, chunk.index, model_variant, routing_decision
A tracing span is created for each emitted chunk that links to the parent request span and includes attributes: tokens_emitted, chunk_latency_ms, origin (cache|generated|fallback)
Tracing context is propagated to any tool/function calls triggered by chunk content (tool-call spans as children of chunk spans), with clear correlation ids
Redaction hook runs before any chunk is written to persisted logs or long-term telemetry; default redaction policy strips emails, credit-card-like numbers, and SSNs
Backwards-compatible sampling config so high-volume streams only sample a subset of chunk spans (configurable by customer tier), while still emitting aggregated per-stream metrics
Grafana dashboard and an example Query in Observability runbook that surfaces chunk-level error spikes, fallback rates, and median per-chunk latency
Unit and e2e tests that cover aborted streams, cached-prefix emission, and model-fallbacks with correct span linking and redaction
implementation_notes: Add new metrics: stream.chunk.emitted_latency_ms (histogram), stream.chunk.token_count (counter), stream.chunk.origin (tagged counter)
Span model: parent request span -> stream span -> chunk spans (chunk spans are short-lived; include stacktrace when chunk fails)
Expose a streaming-observability SDK surface for private deployments so customers can adapt sanitizers and sampling policies

Redaction hook: pluggable interface implemented in runtime that runs synchronously before log/telemetry sink; default implementation uses regex + token blacklist; provide opt-out for internal only telemetry
Compatibility: Ensure new metrics and spans are emitted when compatibility layer (v1 API proxy) is active; don't change existing request-level span ids consumers rely on
Performance: avoid per-token allocations in hot path; reuse buffers and only marshal minimal attributes to OTLP exporter
Fallback visibility: when smart-routing triggers fallback model, annotate chunk spans and increment stream.chunk.origin=fallback counter
Rollout plan: feature-flagged at runtime with opt-in for customers; enable in staging and run 48h smoke with synthetic and real traffic
decisions: Use per-chunk spans instead of per-token spans to keep tracing cardinality manageable
Default redaction will be conservative (strip likely-PII), customers can supply custom sanitizer implementations for Private deployments
Emit chunk metrics as OTel metric instruments; provide Prometheus-compatible scrape translation in hosted environment
Sample chunk spans at configurable rate; but always emit aggregate per-stream metrics to preserve observability while controlling storage
risks_and_mitigation: High cardinality from chunk attributes -> mitigate via tag bucketing (e.g., model variants and origin only, avoid full prompt hashes)
Latency overhead from redaction -> run lightweight patterns synchronously and push heavy heuristics to async denormalization path
PII leakage in third-party tool calls -> enforce sanitizer before tool-call invocation and add runtime assertion in tests
Incorrect span linking in compatibility/proxy layers -> add cross-service integration tests that assert trace ids flow through the v1 proxy
